name: Rajasthan
description: Discover the breathtaking seasonal beauty, rich cultural heritage, and legendary gastronomy of Rajasthan.

cuisine.name: Dal Baati Churma
cuisine.desc: Hard wheat balls baked over coal, dipped in ghee, served with lentils & sweet churma.

cuisine.name: Laal Maas
cuisine.desc: Royal spicy mutton curry cooked with Mathania red chilies & yogurt.

cuisine.name: Ghevar
cuisine.desc: Honeycomb dessert soaked in sugar syrup and topped with rabri & pistachio.

festivals.name: Rajasthan Festival
festivals.desc: A vibrant regional celebration of culture and heritage.

topDestinations.name: Jaisalmer Thar Desert
topDestinations.highlight: Camel safari, luxury desert glamping & folk music under starry skies.

topDestinations.name: Jaipur Amber Fort & Hawa Mahal
topDestinations.highlight: Exploring grand pink city palaces under mild winter sun.

topDestinations.name: Udaipur Lake Palace & Pichola Lake
topDestinations.highlight: Romantic boat ride past white marble palaces at sunset.

travelTips: Pack warm winter coats for desert cold nights
Book Jaisalmer Desert Festival tickets in advance
